scope: Corollary 6.6 of the manuscript “Algebraic Kuga–Satake correspondences and Hodge conjectures on a K3 quadratic locus” (preprints/Algebraic-Kuga-Satake-correspondences-and-Hodge-conjectures-on-a-K3-quadratic-locus-September-30-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 032 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c9fde2b758f25505), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 49. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix abelian-cover data and a section pencil for which Theorems 3.1, 3.3 and 5.1 apply, with nonconstant U-period along the pencil and simple Ut outside a countable set. On a nonempty open of that pencil, for all but countably many b, there is an algebraic correspondence Θb ∈ CH2 (S0 b × Xb)Q whose action on Ub is the given identification with H2(Xb)j=+, δ=−.
